faq.q: Why did gold and silver prices fall recently?
faq.a: Gold and silver prices fell primarily due to a strengthening US dollar and a hawkish stance from the US Federal Reserve, which implies higher interest rates, making non-yielding assets less attractive.

faq.q: Is this a good time to buy gold?
faq.a: Whether it's a good time to buy depends on your personal financial goals and investment horizon. Short-term dips can offer opportunities for long-term investors to accumulate gold at lower prices, especially through rupee cost averaging.

faq.q: How is investment in gold taxed in India?
faq.a: Capital gains from selling physical gold, Gold ETFs, or digital gold are taxed as Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) if held for less than 36 months, or Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) with indexation if held for more than 36 months.

SGBs are government securities denominated in grams of gold. They offer a fixed interest rate and the capital gains are tax-exempt if held till maturity (8 years), making them a tax-efficient way to invest in gold.

faq.q: Does the US dollar always impact gold prices?
faq.a: Generally, yes. Since gold is primarily dollar-denominated, a stronger US dollar typically makes gold more expensive for non-dollar holders, often leading to an inverse relationship between the two.

faq.q: Should I sell my gold now due to the price drop?
faq.a: A short-term price drop is usually not a reason to sell, especially if your investment goal for gold is long-term diversification or inflation hedging. Review your original investment thesis before making any hasty decisions.
